blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Power interruptions may hound Visayas consumers on Tuesday as the grid continues to suffer from insufficient electricity supply. In an advisory, the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. READ: Higher electricity demand seen in 2027 A yellow alert would likewise be in effect from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., and 7 p.m. to 9 p.m. As of 1:30 p.m., the available capacity was 2,283 megawatts (MW) while peak demand was 2,435 MW.
